text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: elevated 5xx rate for model-runner (svc:model-runner-prod) — potential segfaults / OOMs during long inference requests. Auto-escalation to oncall.

erin-oncall: I'm taking pager, pinging runtime team. any obvious customer impact?

alice-sre: Seeing 502s spike starting ~3158765300, per-gateway error burst ~12% -> customers with long contexts affected.

carol-runtime: stacktraces show repeated SIGSEGV in libattention.so at kv_cache_update()+0x1b4. also kernel OOM events on a few pods.

bob-eng: can you paste a sample log tail?

carol-runtime: ```
[2026-03-17T08:10:02Z] model-runner[pid=2345]: segfault at 0 ip 00007f8e3a1b2c4f sp 00007ffd9c1e5a70 error 4 in libattention.so[7f8e39f00000+1a0000]
[2026-03-17T08:10:03Z] kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 2345 (model-runner) total-vm:12457800kB, anon-rss:9875600kB
```

erin-oncall: tagging customer-ops for impact assessment. @dave-custops fyi — high-level?

dave-custops: we've got a handful of customer dashboards showing increased request failures on >2048 token flows. Not yet SLA-level for most, but some pay-tier customers reported degraded quality. Preparing customer note draft.

alice-sre: current mitigation ideas — throttle long-seq requests at gateway, route new sessions away from affected pool, and restart crashlooping pods.

carol-runtime: quick mitigation rolled out: set env VAR `KV_CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES=1024` and injected a hot-restart that disables async prefetch for affected model variant. Patching now to limit KV growth.

bob-eng: initiated a graceful rolling restart of model-runner pods on pool-3 (3/12 done). traffic is being drifted by routing policy to fallback-variant (smaller model) for new requests.

erin-oncall: marking runbook step: escalate to infra if OOMs persist after kv limit. also increase node ephemeral storage?

carol-runtime: note — reproducer: sending repeated growing-prefix prompts causes KV cache to grow without bound due to a bug in cache eviction path. Fix will be a short patch to eviction index. Will open PR and hotpatch.

bob-eng: temporary routing rule: any request with tokens > 2048 gets 429-with-retry-after header and is routed to offline-queue for customer ops to triage. This prevents live OOMs while we hotfix.

dave-custops: drafted customer-facing line: "We're investigating elevated error rates affecting very long context requests — temporary limits may apply while we mitigate. We'll update in 30m." Approve? (will send once you confirm)

erin-oncall: approved, send. add pointer to status page.

carol-runtime: deploying hotpatch PR-#4098 to fix eviction index; patch includes an extra guard in kv_cache_update() and a memory soft-limit enforcement path. ETA ~12m to rollout.

alice-sre: monitoring dashboards: 5xx rate dropped from 12% -> 4% after routing & restarts. latency for fallback-variant up but stable.

bob-eng: one odd node shows repeated kernel OOM despite pod restarts — moving workloads off node and cordoning it. filing infra ticket.

carol-runtime: post-hotpatch validation plan: long-run fuzz test, run kv gc with synthetic prefixes, and enable canary for 10% traffic to patched pool for 1h before full rollout.

erin-oncall: handoff: I'm paged now but @alice-sre will continue post-mitigation follow-ups and own postmortem. Next on-call please pick up after me if anything re-escalates.

dave-custops: customer note sent. will track replies.

alice-sre: setting incident status to "mitigating" on tracker. capturing timelines and logs. Please upload crash dumps to /incidents/3158765432/artifacts.

carol-runtime: uploaded core dumps + filtered stacktrace (links internal). opening postmortem draft. root cause likely bug in eviction index + insufficient guard for extreme-sequence workloads.

bob-eng: follow-ups: add a circuit-breaker at API layer for >X tokens, add alert for KV cache growth, include automated node cordon when kernel OOM rate > 3/hr.

erin-oncall: closing pager if 5xx remains <5% for next 15m. keep this thread updated with PR numbers and customer impact. :white_check_mark:

alice-sre: last note — if customers need to run long contexts, recommend Dedicated/private deployment with tuned quantization & larger memory nodes until permanent fix ships.
